PORT.description: Port the Rackpad server listens on.

DATABASE_PATH.description: Filesystem path for the SQLite database. Backed by the /data Railway volume.

HOST.description: Host address to bind. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Railway.

NODE_ENV.description: Node environment. Keep production for Railway.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Trust reverse proxy headers. Set to 1 if behind Railway's proxy (recommended).

APP_URL.description: Public URL for OIDC redirects and links. Auto-derived from Railway public domain.

OIDC_ENABLED.description: Enable OIDC single sign-on. Configure OIDC_* vars in Variables tab before enabling.
